production.oldDataOperation: INSERT ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING; no existing-row updates

planning.meaning: 10 fresh twenty-question papers OR 20 fresh ten-question papers, not both independently; mixed modes share history.
planning.workloadAssumption: Capacity-planning target only, not measured returning-user behavior or an official educational standard.
planning.finiteBank: When unseen eligible groups run out, recycle transparently. Reordering does not create new content.
planning.quotaWarning: Total groups alone do not guarantee quota-balanced papers; component deficits must be filled too.

limitations: This release is a first expansion, not completion of the all-subject 200-group target.
Assistant review is not independent teacher certification.
Lexical similarity screening is not a semantic proof.
Published catalog and selector were simulated locally; no signed-in learner test was submitted.
